song.name: Learning to Fly
song.plot: Anya trains with Seraphina to harness her dual light-and-void nature — learning to wield the Void-Echo within her rather than fear it. The scholar becomes a fighter of her own strange kind.
song.analysis: Full-structure restore of the kept song: every original section (Verse 1, Pre-chorus, Chorus, Verse 2, Pre-chorus, Chorus x2, Bridge, Outro) preserved in order, line-by-line syllable counts matched, ≥70% verbatim. Anchored: Seraphina named as the one who frees Anya's soul in the first pre-chorus; Verse 2 keeps the "we" frame but ends on the Void-Echo dual-nature line "We weave the darkness with the light"; the Bridge breaks through "the boundaries of the Void" (she is immune to it) instead of the sky. POV Anya. Suggested Suno direction: rising empowerment rock — anthemic chorus, warm guitar lift, a voice gaining wings.
